svg.title: The Solar — Astronomer’s window
svg.desc: An astronomer table, ward focus and archive door share the top chamber. Climb the window ledges to an exterior stargazing balcony; the return remains obvious. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: An astronomer table, ward focus and archive door share the top chamber. Climb the window
ledges to an exterior stargazing balcony; the return remains obvious.
